post.text:
You're staring at another world right now.

That rusty, rocky landscape? Not a desert in Arizona.
Not a movie set.

That's Mars.

A planet sitting 140 million miles from where you're sitting.

Let that sink in. Every grain of red dust, every shadow stretching across those dunes, https://t.co/tmqP1cgTfh

description.description: A sequence of four frames showing a 360-degree panoramic view of the Martian landscape as captured by a rover. The terrain consists of light-colored, rocky ground with rolling hills and a hazy, salmon-colored sky. In the first frame, a small, white cylindrical component is visible in the foreground. By the fourth frame, the rover's robotic arm and instrument turret are visible, extending into the frame over the rocky surface.
